Friday, November 20, 2026


**Dear Shareholders and Investors,**


Nordic American Tankers Limited (NYSE:NAT) conducted its Annual General Meeting of Shareholders (the “Meeting”) today, on November 20, 2026.


We experienced the highest turnout for years at this AGM and all resolutions were approved and adopted at the Meeting:
Election of Herbjorn Hansson, Alexander Hansson, Jenny Chu and Jim Kelly to serve as Directors of the Board.


Approval of the appointment of KPMG as the Company’s independent auditors.


We are in a strong market and prospects are good.


For further information on Nordic American Tankers, please see[www.nat.bm](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=8zpTjtAr_6NtmTVAyaLXCWzkwS64XaQxgT7zwjWHT3kx1rNHhN8UgEE1NDseRU-le3Efln_EKAEj958KyqBvQ2K839DvyfVAYVFomXaf63C83xYEnIImdUQsrVzW-sBGlusvChyZRufv4FImL8Lf_FG-sq0OrHjyjt6G7Cj9uNbVDi885u3Tx17CXUybtU8rzRXejcsUTAfaQo_ULPhyX5eyZ_56EdxO08wr-6cPUZSHWWTLv7-wxNW3YRfX26crovpKd1aLsaWUpqgy8VEDkDChBAdsUZOuB0yt70_80O1BxiHALmIZ7tF3y05VELA8RPz_qF5wTpsSa2i2eXmw86fEvxhKWN17uLiF5qeODmmOiYrj59KPM0x6OwHqPok7YAgkxmfTYsf8oH1D2S3W7ojcQh6Ttb2zuV6WoQ0A3-U=)
